about: Request an electronic marriage contract for Muslim or non-Muslim couples.
note: Requirements read from the official MOJ service page on the checked date. MOJ fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. The page prints the fee without a currency, AED assumed. Marriage contract request. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Non-Muslims: both spouses at least 21, a civil marriage between a man and a woman, with legal capacity
Eligibility rules for Muslims are not listed on the page
documents: Muslims: identification of applicant and witnesses and any case documents
Non-Muslims: identity proof, embassy no-objection letter and a medical certificate including genetic testing
Premarital screening at a federal health centre
fees: AED 50 for the marriage contract request
channels: e-marriage portal ezawaj.moj.gov.ae, sign in with UAE PASS
